input.subject: PRICE IMPROVED — 15 Union Square West #12B
input.bodyText:
PRICE IMPROVED — 15 Union Square West #12B just came down.

Now asking $2.2M (previously $2.5M). 2BR/2BA, high floor, southern light, motivated seller. Co-broke 2.5%.

The seller wants this done, so bring me a real buyer and let's make a deal. Showings start immediately — DM me for access.

Gabriela
